dct_description_sm:
Building footprints 1999 - includes approximate building footprints for the downtown peninsula in 1999 as digitized from 1999 orthophotos.

Note: Data are approximate. Care must be taken in using them because of the significant number of changes since collected year. They are best used for comparison purposes only.

Note

The 1999 dataset contains only building footprint polygons, no attribute information.

Data currency

This dataset reflects conditions in 1999 and is not being updated.

Data accuracy

The dataset reflects the approximate building footprints in 1999.
